findings.finding: Italian national wind generation fell 20.3% y/y in July and 24.2% in August 2026 (September +0.8%), against an Italy-wind segment that was 47m of ERG's 119m Q3 2025 EBITDA on 524 GWh, so the Italian wind line is likely down on volume in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ERG's prints are wind-driven and the reaction history is small (cadence-estimated median 1.38%, a lower bound); the FY2025 'low end of guidance on weak wind' print and the Q3 2025 print both drew modest dips (https://ng.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-erg-sees-q3-2025-profits-rise-stock-dips-93CH-2210939)
findings.original_quote: la contrazione della produzione eolica (-24,2%), idroelettrica (-16%), geotermica (-3,4%) [agosto 2026]; luglio: "In flessione la fonte eolica (-20,3%)" (https://euroborsa.it/public/euroborsa/Comunicati_Stampa/Terna/Consumi_elettrici_2026_luglio_ITA_8def93c0b2c7a55.pdf) -- 'a contraction in wind output (-24.2%)' / 'wind down 20.3%'
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Terna's monthly data is public and the sell side models it, so this is a proxy, not a company number. What is not priced is the transmission: national wind is not ERG's fleet (ERG's sites are concentrated in the South, Campania/Puglia/Sicily/Sardinia), the offset from new UK (+120 MW), German and Polish capacity is unknown, and Q3 is ERG's seasonally smallest Italian wind quarter. If the market had fully priced a weak Italian Q3 the stock would not have risen 4.35% in the last five sessions into the print.
findings.independence: none: no peer (Alerion 9M 2026 not yet out) or ERG statement on Q3 production found; the H1 outlook text says early-2026 output was 'in riduzione alle nostre aspettative' (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-07/20260731_187584.pdf)

findings.finding: Italian wholesale power was far above last year through Q3 2026 (PUN Index GME August 2026 180.0 EUR/MWh against a 2025 average of 115.9, late-September prints 202-210), which lifts the capture price on ERG's unhedged and feed-in-premium Italian volumes and partly offsets the lower wind.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no clean history: ERG says its EBITDA 'risente delle politiche di copertura' (hedging), so price spikes have reached it only partly; Websim's Feb 2026 note blamed weaker prices for estimate cuts (https://www.websim.it/azioni/analisi-fondamentale-italia/erg-speculazioni-su-m-a-in-attesa-del-decreto-energia/)
findings.why_not_priced: Also public and modelled, and much of ERG's output is sold forward through PPAs and derivatives, so how much of the price rise ERG captures depends on its hedge book, which only the release discloses. Macro-to-company transmission, so it is sized small; it also partly offsets finding 1, and the two are filed separately because they rest on different series.
findings.independence: Terna's July release names the same heat-driven record demand that drove prices (https://euroborsa.it/public/euroborsa/Comunicati_Stampa/Terna/Consumi_elettrici_2026_luglio_ITA_8def93c0b2c7a55.pdf)

language_note: The Italian primary documents (eMarket STORAGE headers) gave the release TIMESTAMPS that settle the session (in-session, around 11:00-12:45 CET); no English source carries them.
Terna's Italian monthly releases carried the national wind declines (-20.3% Jul, -24.2% Aug); English searches returned only UK and German wind data.
ARERA's Italian bulletin carried the PUN monthly figure (Aug 2026 180.0 vs 2025 115.9).
The Italian calendar release confirmed the 13 Nov BoD date and that the quarterly reports are voluntary (art. 82-ter), published within 45 days.
lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 2.8 to 3.2: the Q3 numbers are not pre-released and a guidance narrowing is possible ('size the move on what is new'; the hunters' moves were too small by a factor of about 3). It stays near the reiterated-guide base of 2.3% because a confirmed guide is the most likely outcome.
Findings left unchanged: both are already sized as macro-to-company proxies with an unsourced bar, and the 3-7 analyst band upsizes only a confirmed company-level number, which neither is.
No offer period, no pre-release and no MAR guidance revision found, so the 'live bid' and 'already told' rules do not move anything.
